// Verification probe, standard library only. Three questions the specification leaves open for a Rust engine on
// Windows:
//   1. Do the arguments (the --mcp-config JSON, `*`, `[1m]`, a path with a space) reach a native program intact?
//   2. Do they reach it through a `.cmd` shim (the shape an npm global install leaves)?
//   3. What exit code does a killed process report?
// usage: probe <fake-claude.exe> <shim.cmd> <out-dir>
use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
use std::thread::sleep;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

fn args_under_test() -> Vec<String> {
    vec![
        "--output-format".into(), "stream-json".into(), "--verbose".into(), "--input-format".into(), "stream-json".into(),
        "--max-turns=50".into(), "--model=deepseek-flash[1m]".into(),
        "--allowedTools=Read,Write,Edit,Bash,Glob,Grep,mcp__tarsee__*".into(),
        "--tools=Read,Write,Edit,Bash,Glob,Grep,mcp__tarsee__*".into(),
        "--mcp-config".into(),
        r#"{"mcpServers":{"tarsee":{"type":"http","url":"http://127.0.0.1:45678/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer ${TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN}"},"alwaysLoad":true}}}"#.into(),
        "--setting-sources=project".into(), "--strict-mcp-config".into(),
        "--permission-mode=bypassPermissions".into(), "--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions".into(),
        "--include-partial-messages".into(), r"--add-dir=C:\some folder\with space & 100%\skills".into(),
    ]
}

fn run_and_read_argv(program: &Path, out: &Path, scenario: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    let _ = fs::remove_file(out);
    let mut cmd = Command::new(program);
    cmd.args(args_under_test())
        .env_clear()
        .env("SystemRoot", env::var("SystemRoot").unwrap_or_default())
        .env("PATH", env::var("PATH").unwrap_or_default())
        .env("COMSPEC", env::var("COMSPEC").unwrap_or_default())
        .env("VSTUB_OUT", out)
        .env("VSTUB_SCENARIO", scenario)
        .stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::piped()).stderr(Stdio::piped());
    let mut child = cmd.spawn().map_err(|e| format!("spawn failed: {e} (kind {:?})", e.kind()))?;
    drop(child.stdin.take());
    let outp = child.wait_with_output().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let text = fs::read_to_string(out).map_err(|e| format!("no record written: {e}; exit {:?}; stderr {}", outp.status.code(), String::from_utf8_lossy(&outp.stderr)))?;
    let first = text.lines().next().unwrap_or("");
    // the record's first line is {"t":..,"ev":"start","argv":[...],...}: cut the argv array out without a JSON library
    let start = first.find("\"argv\":[").ok_or("no argv in the record")? + 7;
    let end = first[start..].find("],\"cwd\"").ok_or("no end of argv")? + start + 1;
    Ok(vec![first[start..end].to_string()])
}

fn json_array(args: &[String]) -> String {
    let mut s = String::from("[");
    for (i, a) in args.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 { s.push(','); }
        s.push('"');
        for c in a.chars() { match c { '"' => s.push_str("\\\""), '\\' => s.push_str("\\\\"), _ => s.push(c) } }
        s.push('"');
    }
    s.push(']');
    s
}

fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    let exe = Path::new(&a[1]);
    let shim = Path::new(&a[2]);
    let dir = Path::new(&a[3]);
    let want = json_array(&args_under_test());

    match run_and_read_argv(exe, &dir.join("probe-native.jsonl"), "exit0-at-once") {
        Ok(v) => println!("1. native .exe: arguments intact = {}", v[0] == want),
        Err(e) => println!("1. native .exe: {e}"),
    }
    match run_and_read_argv(shim, &dir.join("probe-shim.jsonl"), "exit0-at-once") {
        Ok(v) => { println!("2. .cmd shim: arguments intact = {}", v[0] == want); if v[0] != want { println!("   sent : {want}\n   got  : {}", v[0]); } }
        Err(e) => println!("2. .cmd shim: {e}"),
    }

    // 3. kill a process that never exits by itself
    let out = dir.join("probe-kill.jsonl");
    let _ = fs::remove_file(&out);
    let mut child = Command::new(exe)
        .env("VSTUB_OUT", &out).env("VSTUB_SCENARIO", "hang")
        .stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::piped()).stderr(Stdio::piped())
        .spawn().expect("spawn");
    let mut stdin = child.stdin.take().unwrap();
    stdin.write_all(b"{\"type\":\"user\",\"message\":{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"hi\"}]}}\n").unwrap();
    sleep(Duration::from_millis(700));
    let t = Instant::now();
    child.kill().expect("kill");
    let status = child.wait().expect("wait");
    println!("3. killed with Child::kill(): status.code() = {:?}, success = {}, wait returned after {} ms", status.code(), status.success(), t.elapsed().as_millis());
}
